text:
Maria (CSM): Heads-up — Convexity Labs flagged. DAU for the generation route dropped ~48% WoW and active seats fell from 42 -> 18. Renewal is in ~6 weeks. Can we huddle quick? Dashboard: https://redwood.app/metrics/convexity

Sam (CS Ops): I pulled logs — embedding calls are down ~60%, generation volume lower but latency tail increased. No 5xx. Suspect client-side batch size change or a routing policy shift.

Dina (AE): Oof. Who's the champion now? Any procurement nudges?

Maria (CSM): Champion (Ben) left last month. New PM Rina hasn't engaged with our team yet. Procurement CFO pinged for cost savings but no active pilot requests.

Oliver (Product): Do we see any error bursts or 429s tied to model variants? Need the p95/p99 numbers.

Sam (CS Ops): p50 steady, p95 jumped 820ms -> 1.4s last 10 days. Retries up slightly; SDK v2.1 has a known backoff behavior that could surface if client changed batch sizes. No systemic 5xx.

Kai (Support): Opened ticket C-4821 and messaged Rina for repro steps. She replied that their infra team capped burst concurrency last week. CC'ing Dina for commercial context.

Dina (AE): Ok — I'll try to get an exec intro and surface a short remediation offer. Would we consider a 30-day Dedicated pilot (discounted) to stabilize them through renewal? Need legal to confirm quick SOW.

Maria (CSM): Customer feedback also mentions "slower responses and occasional truncation" in outputs. Could be max_tokens or model trimming. Oliver, any variant rollouts two weeks ago?

Oliver (Product): We did a cost-driven variant rollout ~14 days ago that tightens max_tokens and token heuristics for some routes. I'll check if Convexity was routed to that variant.

OpsBot: Scheduled: Convexity healthcheck (template: perf+truncation) — results attached to C-4821. ETA ~30m.

Sam (CS Ops): Proposed immediate plan — 1) Dina: exec intro + offer pilot by EOD; 2) Maria: run targeted prompt-eval to reproduce truncation today; 3) Oliver: confirm model/variant assignment by tomorrow 12:00PT; 4) Sam/Kai: validate SDK & client batch behavior and confirm concurrency caps with infra. If capacity-limited, short Dedicated window as Dina suggested.

Maria (CSM): Assigning owners: Dina (AE) owner for exec intro — ETA EOD; Oliver (Product) to confirm variant by tomorrow 12pm; Sam (CS Ops) to complete logs + SDK check by 2pm; Kai (Support) owning C-4821 updates, will update by 1pm. I'll draft the customer note and proposed pilot offer. Any objections?

Dina (AE): No objections. I'll start legal loop for short SOW and ping finance about a one-off pilot discount.

Maria (CSM): Great — tagging @here for visibility. I'll post a short playbook (root cause actions + customer-facing note) after we confirm model routing. :thumbsup:
